message.content:
Send an email to kimse991228@gmail.com reporting the cvbml01 Solid ANSYS (pymapdl) simulation batch is COMPLETE.

Subject: ✅ Solid sim (cvbml01) complete — 366/368 FC results, 2 cases need a code fix

Body (plain, friendly, concise):
- The dist Type1 solid structural simulation (PyMAPDL / ANSYS v251, PCG solver) finished on cvbml01 for project 65_final_0723.
- Result: 366 / 368 cases done (each with peak + low). Output: solid_0723/case_{i}/ansys_results_dist_0723/FC_case_{i}_{peak,low}.vtk (fibrous-cap results, ~12 MB each).
- Integrity: all 366 have BOTH peak and low vtks, 0 empty files, 0 half-done. Clean.
- (16 cases were skipped throughout because they have no dist mesh: 10 27 63 65 114 127 151 215 231 240 250 287 305 343 376 380 — so 368 was the achievable target.)
- 2 cases FAILED and could not be recovered: case 168 and case 381.
  - Root cause is NOT the solver or environment — it is a deterministic Python IndexError in the FC-extraction post-processing step:
    - case 168: "index -31 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 22"
    - case 381: "index 16 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 12"
  - These reproduce on a clean re-run, so they need a code/data fix in _save_fc_results_rst (the fibrous-cap element-averaging indexing) for those two meshes — re-running or switching solver won't help.
- Note on earlier PCG "segfaults": during the run, a few cases (85, 319) failed transiently due to leftover ANSYS processes contending on the machine; they were automatically retried on a clean environment and succeeded. Only 168 and 381 remain.
- Config: PCG solver, nproc 30, sequential, restart-free wipe (kept only FC vtk). ~5 min/case. Total wall-clock ~35.5 hours (2025-07-25 23:15 → 2025-07-27 ~10:48 KST).

Action needed: only cases 168 and 381 remain — they need the FC-extraction indexing bug looked at. Everything else is ready for downstream analysis.
